> **What this fork adds on top of upstream 0.1.0:**
>
> - An orthogonal **code-skeleton co"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"mpression gate** (`codeSkeleton.enabled`, default off): the first exposure of an oversized fresh sou"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"rce-code tool result can keep a skeleton of imports and declarations — bodies elided, error lines ke"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"pt — before the regular reducers run.
> - A settings toggle for that gate in the same selector setti"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"ngs section, independent of every compression profile.
> - An ESLint baseline wired into CI, a `test"},{"id":"p5s6","text":":watch` TDD loop, and documentation in English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> [!IMPORTANT]
> This project supports **DeepSeek models only**. Lossless measurement and lossy comp"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ression depend on the bundled official DeepSeek tokenizers (`deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro`, "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`). Everything else fails open and keeps original tool results. See the"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" upstream README for the full safety model."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> [!TIP]
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## What it is"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Long-running agent tasks accumulate a large amount of tool output. This community plugin adds select"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"able, auditable policies for reducing that tool-result context without modifying DeepSeek Harness co"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"e, auditable policies for reducing that tool-result context without modifying DeepSeek Harness core:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Fresh** pre-compresses a newly oversized tool-result segment before the model receives it.
- **A"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ggregate** pre-compresses fresh material again when it still grows beyond its budget.
- **History / "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"micro-compact** replaces eligible old tool results while preserving recent working context.
- **Tail"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"Trim** is an optional Custom-only tail reduction path.
- **Native** preserves the Harness-style head"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"/middle/tail trimming as one explicit profile.
- **Code skeleton (new, orthogonal gate)** — see belo"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"iddle/tail trimming as one explicit profile.
- **Code skeleton (new, orthogonal gate)** — see below."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Every decision is recorded: stage, reducer, trigger, skip reason, and exact token counts where avail"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" decision is recorded: stage, reducer, trigger, skip reason, and exact token counts where available."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Code skeleton gate (new)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"When the gate is enabled, an oversized **fresh source-code tool result** (for example a large `read_"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"file`) first tries a skeleton reduction: imports and type/function/class declarations are kept, func"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"tion bodies are elided with a marker, and error lines inside elided bodies are preserved. If the ske"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"leton cannot be produced or verified, the result falls back to the original head pruning — the gate "},{"id":"p13s5","text":"can never make context worse."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Properties:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Orthogonal**: independent of the selected profile (`balanced`, `savings`, `cache-strict`, `adapt"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ive`, `custom`, `off`, `native`). All profiles get the gate.
- **Off by default**: `codeSkeleton: { "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"enabled: false }` until you turn it on.
- **Measurement-gated**: requires the exact DeepSeek tokeniz"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"er; without it the plugin fails open.
- **Session-frozen**: like all selector settings, changes affe"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"ct newly observed sessions only.
- **Strictly parsed**: `codeSkeleton` must be exactly `{ enabled: b"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"oolean }`; malformed values throw on the runtime side and show as unreadable in the browser UI."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Settings UI"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level, and toggle code-skeleton compressi"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"on in the same settings section. The toggle saves on change and shows the saved state on reload."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Monitoring UI"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"While compression runs, the plugin gives you a live view of what it saves: a **compression monitor**"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" panel — net/gross savings, offsets, context usage, cache-hit rate, cost estimate, and the turn-tail"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" intent-summary state, with a per-session resume/disable override right in the panel — next to the s"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ession's context trend chart."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Context trend for a session under compression: per-step / per-turn token composition with a timing o"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"verlay; the scissors mark where reductions landed."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Stats semantics and persistence"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Savings are reported in three distinct semantics — never merged:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Stock (currently active)** — net savings still in effect on the live surface; it rises and falls"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" as compressed content moves in and out.
- **Cumulative (across N calls)** — the stock sampled at ev"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ery request boundary and summed; answers "how much was saved historically" and survives host restart"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"s.
- **Money saved** — cumulative weighted by cache hit/miss at official list prices (deepseek-offic"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"ial official routes only; other routes show the token figure)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Stats persist in SQLite (`~/.dsh/storages/dsh-context-compression/stats.sqlite`) across host restart"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"s; a missing driver or write failure degrades visibly (panel badge, in-memory fallback). Historical "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"sessions are backfilled from on-disk behavior records (host `sessionQuery` service preferred, read-o"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"nly session-log parsing as fallback — session files are never written). Records contain counts, sequ"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ence numbers, session identifiers, and enum component names only; original text and free-form text n"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"ever enter the database. Delete the file to reset stats completely."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The `/ccip` command drives the panel in real time: `rows stock|total|money on|off`, `mode compact|fu"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ll`, `session <id|latest|off>`, `flush`, `backfill pause|resume|status`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"**Recommended: install from npm.** One version covers every supported Harness line — `latest` carrie"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"s the full 17-rc enum (0.1.0-rc.2 → 0.2.1-rc.2); the runtime picks per-line code paths on its own."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- Built and tested against the official DeepSeek Harness releases; peers declare the full supported-"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"hosts enum (`0.1.0-rc.2` → `0.2.1-rc.2`, seven lines) and the plugin uses public plugin and profile "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"APIs only. The supported list is generated into the managed block above by `scripts/sync-hosts.mjs` "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"from `scripts/hosts.mjs`.
- Requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24` and pnpm `11.7.0`.
- The plugin uses on"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"ly public Harness extension APIs and does not modify Harness core code. Unofficial community project"},{"id":"p31s6","text":", not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek."}],"truncated":true}
